title: Legal & Liasoning executive
description:
Job Description – Legal Documentation & Liaisoning Executive

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Department:** Legal

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare, review, verify, and maintain legal documents, agreements, affidavits, undertakings, sale deeds, lease deeds, and other property-related documents.
* Handle legal liaisoning with government departments, revenue offices, municipal authorities, sub-registrar offices, and other statutory authorities.
* Coordinate land and property-related matters, including land records, mutation entries, survey records, land conversion, and property registration.
* Liaise with government officials and relevant authorities for obtaining approvals, permissions, NOCs, certificates, and statutory clearances.
* Conduct regular visits to government offices for document submissions, verification, follow-ups, and resolution of pending matters.
* Coordinate with advocates, legal consultants, and internal departments for legal documentation and compliance requirements.
* Track the status of legal applications, registrations, approvals, and other pending matters.
* Maintain accurate records of legal documents, government correspondence, registrations, and approvals.
* Ensure timely completion of legal formalities and provide regular updates to management.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate in Law (LL.B.) or any relevant graduate qualification.
* Strong knowledge of legal documentation, land records, property matters, and government procedures.

Required Experience

* **3–5 years of relevant experience, with strong hands-on experience in legal documentation and liaisoning with government authorities.**
* Experience in land, property, and revenue-related matters in Gujarat is preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong liaisoning, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Knowledge of land and revenue procedures and property registration.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple matters independently and maintain confidentiality.

Work Location: In person
